Package neqsim.process.logic.action

Class TripCompressorAction

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.logic.action.TripCompressorAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, LogicAction
public final class TripCompressorAction extends Object implements LogicAction, Serializable
Commands a native compressor shutdown and verifies actual shaft speed rather than command bookkeeping.

The process runner must advance Compressor.updateDynamicState(double) once per physical step. The compressor's configured shutdown profile and driver or rate-limit policy determine the speed response. This action does not infer an inertia model, open a recycle valve, isolate a process boundary or establish restart permissives. Those actions require separate actual targets in the cause-and-effect sequence.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Re-arms the action for a new execution without changing equipment state.

      Stateless actions need no work. Stateful custom actions must override this hook to clear cached execution or branch-selection state. Resetting an action does not energize, reopen or reset the target equipment and does not establish a restart permissive.

      Specified by:
